result:
This matches the upstream commit's stat exactly (3 files, +63/-38 net). The change is complete and verified:

- **`src/jinja2/sandbox.py`**: moved `str.format`/`str.format_map` sandboxing from call-time (`inspect_format_method` + `format_string`, invoked only from `SandboxedEnvironment.call()`) to access-time (`wrap_str_format`, invoked from `getattr`/`getitem`). Now the bound method returned by attribute/item access is itself replaced with a safe wrapper, so any indirect call to it — e.g. storing it and invoking it from inside a custom filter's own Python code, bypassing `environment.call()` entirely — is still sandboxed.
- **`tests/test_security.py`**: added `test_indirect_call`, which reproduces exactly this bypass (a filter that calls `value.run(arg)` directly) and confirms it raises `SecurityError` — I verified it fails without the fix and passes with it.
- **`CHANGES.rst`**: added the changelog entry with the GHSA reference.

Full test suite (900 tests) passes.
